questions.evidence:
[Fair notice] Each pair has six minutes, with three minutes per reader. Share one changed answer and explain the textual clue. Names and scores may be covered. The event is for exchanging methods, not ranking students or predicting official exam levels.

[Pair record] Ava first chose a picnic because that word appeared in the passage. She changed to an indoor visit after noticing 'but finally decided.' Leon first accepted a poster's largest time, then checked the direction heading and revised his bus plan.

[Draft report] Twelve volunteers shared examples. Every volunteer explained one revision. Therefore, every student in the school now understands all reading questions and will reach the same exam level. The editor underlines the final sentence and asks for a narrower conclusion.

The revised report says the twelve participants practiced explaining a changed answer with evidence. It does not claim that one successful explanation establishes every reading skill. Ava and Leon leave with strategies to test on unfamiliar passages, where further practice can show what they have learned.
questions.explanation: 公告及紀錄只支持此次練習活動，不支持普遍學力結論。
options: All students mastered every skill because twelve people spoke.
Ava and Leon can now answer every unfamiliar passage without checking.
The event ranked participants using hidden scores.
Twelve participants practiced evidence-based revisions without establishing school-wide exam outcomes.
questions.prompt: Which summary is best supported by all sections?

questions.evidence: The revised report says the twelve participants practiced explaining a changed answer with evidence. It does not claim that one successful explanation establishes every reading skill. Ava and Leon leave with strategies to test on unfamiliar passages, where further practice can show what they have learned.
questions.explanation: 新情境可檢查能否遷移方法，不能以熟題一次成功當全面掌握。
options: To prove the draft's broad claim without new work.
To avoid examining further evidence.
To see whether they can apply the methods beyond the examples already discussed.
To replace every source with their first guesses.
questions.prompt: Why do Ava and Leon plan to test strategies on unfamiliar passages?
